name: 折返しラベルを含む一般設定セクション
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0004. Image1 ORIGINAL source controls all icon and fine control details. Image2 is the generated v1 edit target. Image3 is secondary Japanese content/layout mock. Keep all six Japanese labels and their current order, exact two-line row3 wrapping, slate tiles, green ON switch, other icon geometry, row alignment, dividers and pure white background. Make ONLY these corrections: Remove the outermost extra rounded card and its outline/shadow around the heading and list; retain a single white rounded six-row list card with subtle soft shadow. The heading 一般 sits directly on pure-white canvas above that single card. Replace row2 shortcut icon with the ORIGINAL precise glyph: a slim curved path rises from the bottom-right, curls leftwards then upward to the top, ending in a small diagonal upper-right arrowhead; match the source original Siri Shortcuts glyph, not a generic thick bent right arrow. Keep equal optical stroke weight to other white glyphs on slate tile. Preserve Meiryo Regular14/24 labels and12/16 section heading, tracking0. Do not change text, row heights, grid/ring/shield/info/screen or switch state. No added card, icon, content, watermark or phone.
reviewNotes: v1修正後を原版に照合し目視。二重カードを除去し、一般見出しが白canvas上、単一6行カードになった。ショートカットは原版に沿う上向きカーブへ修正。6種の原版glyph、6日本語項目、3行目の2行折返し、右側ON、区切り、白面とslate統一を確認。ONのみ森緑で状態を保持。厳密なfont同一性・実操作・native編集・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
